desc: Graphical User Interface for SELinux policy.
r: sepolicy-gui - Graphical User Interface for SELinux policy.
Use sepolicy gui to run the graphical user interface, which allows you to explore how SELinux confines different process domains.

-h, --help
Display help message
-d, --domain
Initialize gui to the selected domain
